rule: Rest on primary lifts: power 150 s, strength 180 s, test 180 s, hypertrophy 120 s
summary: Longer rest (3-5 min) favours strength gains; for hypertrophy >60-90 s is enough with little benefit beyond. Current values sit inside the supported ranges.

sources.note: de Salles 2009 review: 3-5 min rest gives larger absolute strength gains
Grgic 2017 SR: short and long rest both build muscle; long rest may help trained lifters
Singer 2024 Bayesian MA: small hypertrophy benefit for >60 s rest; no clear difference beyond ~90 s
